findings.description: The RDS instance has storage_encrypted = false, so the database data and backups are stored unencrypted at rest. This exposes sensitive application data if the underlying storage volumes are compromised.
publicly_accessible = true exposes the RDS instance to the internet rather than keeping it confined to private subnets, expanding the attack surface for the database.
The egress security group rule allows all traffic (protocol -1, ports 0-0) to 0.0.0.0/0, providing a data exfiltration path and channel to command-and-control infrastructure.
This rule allows egress traffic on all ports and protocols to 0.0.0.0/0, providing unrestricted outbound access that enables data exfiltration and command-and-control communication.

The database password (var.password) is embedded in plain text in the EC2 instance user_data startup script, where it is readable by anyone with describe permissions on the instance. Secrets must never be stored in this manner.
The EC2 instance role policy grants wildcard actions on s3, ec2, and rds across all resources (Resource: *), equivalent to near-administrative access far beyond what the workload requires.

The default administrative username 'admin' is hardcoded, and the database password (var.password) is embedded in plain text in the EC2 user_data, making it readable by anyone with describe permissions on the instance.
